description: Update a collection's settings: rename it, set whether it is commercial, set its description (plain text, up to 200 characters) or credits heading (up to 120 characters; it replaces the default heading in exported credits), or archive or unarchive it. Use it for collection-level changes. Not for one item or the track order; use update_collection_item or reorder_collection for those. Returns the updated collection. Needs a signed-in account. An empty description or credits_heading clears it. A rename, commercial, description or credits heading change needs the current revision and fails with stale_revision when it is out of date; archived alone needs none and is safe to repeat. Archived collections are hidden from list_collections and search_collections unless asked for. A collection holding CC BY-NC tracks cannot be made commercial. Example: {"collection_id":"3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4f6b-9c2d-1a2b3c4d5e6f","revision":3,"name":"Trailer cues"}.

archived.description: true archives, false unarchives. Needs no revision when sent alone.

collection_id.description: The id of a collection returned by list_collections or create_collection (a UUID).

commercial.description: true marks the collection for commercial use (refused while it holds CC BY-NC tracks); false allows CC BY-NC tracks.

credits_heading.description: The heading of the credits block, up to 120 characters. An empty string goes back to the default.

description.description: One line of plain text, up to 200 characters. An empty string clears it.

revision.description: The collection's current revision, from get_collection or list_collections. Needed for name, commercial, description and credits_heading changes, so another edit is not overwritten.

name: update_collection

archived_at.description: When the collection was archived, or null.

credits_heading.description: The credits block heading, or null for the default.

description.description: One line of plain text, or null.

read_only.description: true when a lapsed Pro plan has made this collection view-and-export only.

title: Update a collection
